NOT_ZIP.title: Not a ZIP File
NOT_ZIP.message: Please upload the ZIP archive from Instagram, not a folder or other file type.
NOT_ZIP.fix: Look for a file ending in .zip in your Downloads folder. It should be named something like "instagram-username-date.zip".

HTML_FORMAT.title: Wrong Format: HTML
HTML_FORMAT.message: You downloaded your data in HTML format, but this tool requires JSON format to work.
HTML_FORMAT.fix: Go back to Instagram Settings → Download Your Data → Select "JSON" format (not HTML) → Request download again.

NOT_INSTAGRAM_EXPORT.title: Not an Instagram Export
NOT_INSTAGRAM_EXPORT.message: This ZIP file doesn't appear to be an Instagram data export.
NOT_INSTAGRAM_EXPORT.fix: Make sure you're uploading the ZIP file from Instagram's "Download Your Data" feature, not a random ZIP file.

INCOMPLETE_EXPORT.title: Incomplete Export
INCOMPLETE_EXPORT.message: The export is missing the "Followers and following" data.
INCOMPLETE_EXPORT.fix: Re-request your data from Instagram and make sure to select "Followers and following" in the data types.

NO_DATA_FILES.title: No Follower Data Found
NO_DATA_FILES.message: Could not find following.json or followers files in the expected location.
NO_DATA_FILES.fix: Make sure you selected "Followers and following" when requesting your data, and that you're uploading the correct ZIP file.

MISSING_FOLLOWING.title: Missing Following Data
MISSING_FOLLOWING.message: following.json not found — cannot detect who you follow.
MISSING_FOLLOWING.fix: Re-request your data and ensure "Followers and following" is selected.

MISSING_FOLLOWERS.title: Missing Followers Data
MISSING_FOLLOWERS.message: followers_*.json files not found — cannot detect who follows you.
MISSING_FOLLOWERS.fix: Re-request your data and ensure "Followers and following" is selected.

CORRUPTED_ZIP.title: Corrupted ZIP File
CORRUPTED_ZIP.message: The ZIP file appears to be damaged or corrupted and cannot be opened.
CORRUPTED_ZIP.fix: Try downloading your Instagram data again. Make sure the download completed fully before uploading.

ZIP_ENCRYPTED.title: Password-Protected ZIP
ZIP_ENCRYPTED.message: The ZIP file is password-protected, but Instagram exports are not encrypted.
ZIP_ENCRYPTED.fix: This may not be a valid Instagram data export. Request a new export from Instagram Settings.

EMPTY_FILE.title: Empty File
EMPTY_FILE.message: The uploaded file is empty (0 bytes).
EMPTY_FILE.fix: The download may have been interrupted. Try downloading your data again from Instagram.

FILE_TOO_LARGE.title: File Too Large
FILE_TOO_LARGE.message: File is {{sizeMb}}MB, which exceeds the 500MB limit.
FILE_TOO_LARGE.fix: Try requesting a smaller data export from Instagram, or use a desktop browser with more memory.

JSON_PARSE_ERROR.title: Invalid Data Format
JSON_PARSE_ERROR.message: One or more JSON files in the export are malformed or corrupted.
JSON_PARSE_ERROR.fix: This may indicate a corrupted download. Request a fresh data export from Instagram.

INVALID_DATA_STRUCTURE.title: Unexpected Data Structure
INVALID_DATA_STRUCTURE.message: The JSON files exist but have an unexpected structure.
INVALID_DATA_STRUCTURE.fix: Instagram may have changed their export format. Please report this issue.

WORKER_TIMEOUT.title: Processing Timeout
WORKER_TIMEOUT.message: The file took too long to process (over 60 seconds).
WORKER_TIMEOUT.fix: Try closing other browser tabs to free up resources, or use a smaller export file.

WORKER_INIT_ERROR.title: Processing Failed to Start
WORKER_INIT_ERROR.message: Could not initialize the file processor.
WORKER_INIT_ERROR.fix: Try refreshing the page. If the problem persists, try a different browser.

WORKER_CRASHED.title: Processing Crashed
WORKER_CRASHED.fix: This may be due to insufficient memory. Try closing other tabs or using a smaller file.

INDEXEDDB_ERROR.title: Storage Error
INDEXEDDB_ERROR.message: Could not save data to browser storage.
INDEXEDDB_ERROR.fix: Try clearing browser cache or using a different browser. Private/incognito mode may have limited storage.

QUOTA_EXCEEDED.title: Storage Full
QUOTA_EXCEEDED.message: Browser storage quota has been exceeded.
QUOTA_EXCEEDED.fix: Clear some browser data in Settings, or try a different browser profile.

IDB_NOT_SUPPORTED.title: Storage Not Available
IDB_NOT_SUPPORTED.message: IndexedDB storage is not available in this browser.
IDB_NOT_SUPPORTED.fix: This app requires IndexedDB. Disable incognito/private mode, or try Chrome/Firefox/Safari.

IDB_PERMISSION_DENIED.title: Storage Permission Denied
IDB_PERMISSION_DENIED.message: The browser denied access to storage.
IDB_PERMISSION_DENIED.fix: Check browser settings to allow storage for this site, or disable strict privacy mode.

UPLOAD_CANCELLED.title: Upload Cancelled
UPLOAD_CANCELLED.fix: Click "Try Again" to upload your file.

CRYPTO_NOT_AVAILABLE.title: Security Feature Unavailable
CRYPTO_NOT_AVAILABLE.message: Your browser does not support secure hashing (crypto.subtle).
CRYPTO_NOT_AVAILABLE.fix: Please use a modern browser (Chrome 37+, Firefox 34+, Safari 11+) with HTTPS.

NETWORK_ERROR.title: Network Error
NETWORK_ERROR.message: A network error occurred during upload.
NETWORK_ERROR.fix: Check your internet connection and try again.

UNKNOWN.title: Upload Error
UNKNOWN.message: An unexpected error occurred while processing your file.
UNKNOWN.fix: Try uploading the file again. If the problem persists, make sure the ZIP file is not corrupted.
